story.title: Democrats Prepare Investigations into Trump Following Midterms
story.summary: Democrats are strategizing to investigate President Donald Trump's administration and business dealings if they regain control of Congress after the midterms. Their plans include circumventing potential obstruction from the White House and avoiding the impeachment deadlock that characterized Trump's first term. If Republicans lose their majority, Trump's remaining time in office may be dominated by these Democratic-led inquiries, which could even lead to another impeachment.

related_stories.title: Voters Cast Ballots in 2026 U.S. Midterm Elections Amid Predictions of Change
related_stories.summary: On November 3, 2026, Americans are voting in midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the final two years of President Donald Trump's term. All 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats, and 36 governorships are at stake. Poll watchers anticipate a potential shift in power, with predictions of a Democratic wave that could challenge the Republican majority.
